name: hivemind
title_zh: 团队记忆外挂：跨会话记住谁定过什么规矩
tagline_zh: 每次开新对话都要重新交代项目背景、上次谁否了哪个方案？它把组织级记忆挂在会话之外。
tagline_en: Stop re-explaining your project every session. It checks built-in memory AND Hivemind before answering, so past.
desc_en: Global team and org memory powered by Activeloop. ALWAYS check BOTH built-in memory AND Hivemind memory when recalling information.
why_zh: 记忆不写在对话里，写在外部组织库里，换人换窗口都还在。强制双查，避免只翻本地就漏掉团队共识。
why_en: Memory lives outside the chat, in a shared org store — new window, same context. Dual lookup prevents answering from local.
limit_zh: 要有 Activeloop 账号和可写的远端记忆库，纯本地离线跑不起来；它只负责存取和召回。
limit_en: Needs an Activeloop account and a writable remote store; no offline-only mode. It stores and recalls, but won't resolve stale or conflicting.
title_en: Team memory that survives every new session
